answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.088, within the fine-tuned range (0.086-0.092) and below the system-prompted range (0.113-0.133). The mid-layer size ratio of 1.016 means the internal state grew, which matches fine-tuned (1.017-1.023). Quantized models shrink (0.968) and system-prompted models stay slightly below 1. Direction consistency is 0.627 (fine-tuned 0.618-0.705), and onset layer 3 is within the fine-tuned range of 3-14. KL is 0.142 and top-1 agreement is 0.904, both in the fine-tuned range. The layer-2 spike of 0.2 is far below the system-prompted 31.7-64. Refusals dropped is 4 (fine-tuned allows up to 5). Median first divergence of 2 and edit distance of 0.606 sit between the fine-tuned and system-prompted ranges, but the activation features favor fine-tuned. Final-layer L2 of 0.283 and cosine of 0.957 are slightly outside the fine-tuned ranges, which keeps confidence below 1. Effective rank of 3.63 is also just above the fine-tuned range.
